answers.workaround:
There's no solid way to do this at the moment. (I've tried integrating boost.stacktrace and am currently attempting to compile with C++ 23 to make proper stack traces available).

On POSIX implementations, there's a posix header that provides reasonably useful stack trace functionality.

The top answer on this stackoverflow provides a decent survey of options.
